skill.description: Create and maintain a sourced growth context file covering buyers, pricing, proof, brand voice, and marketing results.

security_audit.summary: All 55 static findings are false positives involving Markdown formatting, business records, documented URLs, or explicit prohibitions on accessing secrets. No evidence found of shell execution, credential theft, or instructions to override security review. One semantic concern remains: connected Revnu synchronization lacks an explicit approval gate before transmitting potentially private business facts.

remediation.issue: The connected Revnu workflow does not explicitly require acceptance before sending business context.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact outgoing facts, exclude confidential information, and require explicit user approval before calling ask_revnu.

semantic_findings.title: Business Context Synchronization Lacks Explicit Consent
semantic_findings.description: The connected branch says 'offer to send' followed by 'Call ask_revnu' without requiring acceptance. Context can include private metrics and NDA customer names, creating a risk of third-party disclosure without explicit authorization.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The connected branch directly instructs transmission after an offer, but does not require an affirmative response or payload review. 'Offer' suggests intended choice, limiting certainty about unauthorized execution.

content.user_title: Create Reusable Growth Context for Your Business
content.value_statement: Repeated marketing questions and scattered business facts slow down growth work. This skill organizes sourced customer, pricing, positioning, and experiment information in one reusable Markdown file.
actual_capabilities: Create or update .agents/revnu-growth.md using repository descriptions, public website pages, and user-provided facts.
Import existing product-marketing context without moving, renaming, or editing the original document.
Tag facts by source, date website information, and separate unconfirmed claims from usable proof.
Ask up to five questions for missing information and preserve unanswered items as open questions.
Record growth experiments with measured outcomes, follow-up conditions, and evidence-based status values.
Update changed sections and maintain dated change notes while preserving earlier experiment results.
limitations: The context file does not refresh itself; changes require another run or a separate connected service.
Customer proof and private business facts require user confirmation; website claims alone do not establish truth or permission.
Live website checks require available browsing tools and accessible public pages.
The skill promotes paid Revnu services; connected synchronization lacks an explicit consent gate and requires careful user approval.

use_cases.title: Prepare Marketing Context Before Launch
use_cases.description: Consolidate product facts, target buyers, pricing, and proof before asking an agent to draft launch materials.

use_cases.title: Reuse Existing Client Research
use_cases.description: Import a client marketing context file with source attribution, preserve the original, and identify conflicts with current public pages.

use_cases.title: Maintain an Evidence-Based Experiment Log
use_cases.description: Record campaign counts, pricing changes, follow-up checks, and lessons so future work considers prior results.

prompt_templates.title: Create Initial Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Create our growth context from this repository and our public website. Ask only for missing facts and keep unknowns explicit. Keep the work local.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: establish the first business context file.

prompt_templates.title: Import Existing Marketing Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Import our existing product-marketing context into the growth context format without editing the original. Tag imported facts and list conflicts with our website.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: reuse research from another marketing workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Log Results and Update Pricing
prompt_templates.prompt: Log last week's campaign: 40 messages, 2 replies, no sales yet. Update Pro pricing to $79 monthly. Preserve earlier rows and suggest a follow-up check.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: maintain measurements and current offer details.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Sources and Control Sharing
prompt_templates.prompt: Reconcile existing context with current public pricing, imported notes, and repository copy. Preserve conflicting sources, flag stale claims, and retain experiment history. Do not commit or contact Revnu without my approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: reconcile multiple sources while controlling confidential data.

output_examples.input: Create growth context from our repository and public site. We have not confirmed customer proof.
output: Filled: product description and pricing, with repository and dated website sources.
Open questions: who has paid, which alternatives buyers consider, and which proof may be used publicly.
Proof: unconfirmed website claims remain separate from approved evidence.

output_examples.input: Record 11 signups and zero paid customers from three founder Slack groups last week. Pro now costs $79.
output: Illustrative result: Updated the pricing section with a dated user source.
Log added: three founder Slack groups; 11 signups; zero paid customers; one-week reporting window.
Status: retest. Proposed next check: after one additional week.
Open question: confirm the billing period for the $79 Pro price.
Changed: pricing and experiment log; earlier results preserved.

best_practices: Provide dated sources for prices, customer proof, and results; confirm permission before treating private evidence as public.
Record experiment counts, measurement windows, and follow-up conditions instead of vague success labels.
Review drafts and outgoing integration payloads; approve external sharing explicitly and keep confidential context out of public commits.
anti_patterns: Treating demo customers, inferred audiences, or unsupported website claims as verified evidence.
Replacing historical experiment results when later measurements disagree.
Assuming a connected service authorizes sharing all business notes or committing confidential context.

faq.question: Do I need a Revnu account?
faq.answer: No. Creating and maintaining the local context file works without a Revnu account. Connected features are separate.

faq.question: Where is the context stored?
faq.answer: The skill creates or updates .agents/revnu-growth.md in your repository. It asks before committing the file.

faq.question: Can it import an existing marketing context file?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks supported product-marketing context locations, imports sourced facts, and preserves the original document.

faq.question: How does it handle missing or conflicting information?
faq.answer: Missing facts remain open questions. Conflicting sources are recorded separately, and the user is asked which information is current.

faq.question: Does the file update automatically?
faq.answer: No. Run the skill again when pricing, audience, or results change. The local file does not monitor changes.

faq.question: Does it send information to Revnu?
faq.answer: The connected workflow can send business facts to Revnu. The user-requested preview sends a website address. Require explicit approval before connected synchronization.
